title: University of Utah continues reinvestment in AI, behavioral health, nursing

excerpts.exactExcerpt: The university is redirecting $4.95 million into engineering programs, another $4.94 million in artificial intelligence, $3.5 million in behavioral health, $1.8 million in civic engagement education, $1.64 million in biotechnology and $1.5 million in nursing and simulation programs over the three-year reinvestment process.
During the 2025 Legislature, Utah lawmakers required state colleges and universities cut and reinvest $60 million over three years; the U was responsible for one-third of that total.
A competitive AI talent market refined the Responsible AI hiring plan

title: USHE Degree-Granting Institution Strategic Reinvestment Initiative Year Two
publisher: Utah System of Higher Education, Office of the Commissioner

excerpts.exactExcerpt: The bill established a three-year strategic reinvestment requirement for Utah System of Higher Education degree-granting institutions and was coupled with base budget set-asides in the amount of 10% of state tax dollars within institutional instruction budgets.
In order to recover set-aside funds, degree granting institutions must reallocate at least 30% of the equivalent funding amounts in FY 2026, 70% in FY 2027, and 100% in FY 2028.
The University of Utah is proposing to increase its net reinvestment in instruction from the originally approved amount of $5,595,600 to $5,931,393 upon full plan implementation.
The Commissioner recommends that the Board review and approve the University of Utah’s Year Two Strategic Reinvestment Plan.

PHASE 2 FY2027 Total reallocation and reinvestment $6,226,451
PHASE 3 FY2028 Total reallocation and reinvestment $5,875,560
